questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "appetite into the weekend" mean?
options: desire to keep trading active over the weekend
a literal hunger for food on Saturday and Sunday
interest in buying stocks before the weekend ends
a plan to stop trading on Friday
questions.explain_en: Here "appetite" means interest or demand for the stocks, showing investors want to keep buying over the weekend.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「appetite」指的是投資人對股票的興趣或需求，表示他們想在週末持續買進。

options: An amount of income that is not taxed
A bonus payment from the government
